name: Invulnerable
summary:
Invulnerable is an action-packed superhero game where you can fly, destroy environments, and battle other players using powerful abilities. Every fight is dynamic, giving you the freedom to play your way whether that means saving the day or causing chaos.

Choose your path as a hero or villain, team up with friends, or face off in intense showdowns. Your choices shape your story.

So, will you protect the world, or take control of it?
